title: Hotel Booking Decisions
record_unit: One reservation, including reservations later cancelled
business_context: A fictional hotel group wants to understand cancellations and quoted room rates. Explore reservations to identify operationally useful patterns, then explain what management can and cannot conclude.
learner_profile: Business-school introductory analytics students with limited programming experience.
ai_policy: AI tools are allowed throughout. You remain responsible for your data handling, evidence, and conclusions.

learning_objectives.description: Frame useful business questions and explain the comparisons selected.
Guide AI exploration and verify the calculations supporting a finding.
Communicate evidence-based recommendations and distinguish observations from causal hypotheses.

columns.name: LeadDays
columns.description: Days between reservation and scheduled arrival

columns.name: QuotedRate
columns.description: Quoted nightly room rate, including cancelled reservations

patterns.title: Long-lead OTA cancellations
patterns.business_question: Which reservations merit closer cancellation monitoring?
patterns.generation_rule: Raise cancellation probability for OTA reservations booked more than 60 days ahead.
patterns.interaction_policy: Short-lead OTA and Direct share the baseline; do not generalize the OTA interaction to every booking.
patterns.interpretation_limits: This scenario does not identify the causal effect of changing booking terms.

patterns.title: Resort summer quoted rates
patterns.business_question: How does the Resort quoted-rate mix vary by season?
patterns.generation_rule: Add a summer premium to Resort rates.
patterns.interaction_policy: Summer and City weekday premiums apply to different property types.
patterns.interpretation_limits: Quoted rates are not realized revenue, occupancy, or willingness-to-pay estimates.

patterns.title: City weekday quoted rates
patterns.business_question: How do City quoted rates differ across the week?
patterns.interaction_policy: Check within City so the Resort seasonal pattern does not redefine the comparator.
patterns.interpretation_limits: The rates do not establish a causal response to price changes.

checks.description: Cancellation-share difference: OTA lead time above 60 days minus at most 60 days
Mean quoted rate difference in USD: Resort June–August minus other months
Mean quoted rate difference in USD: City weekdays minus weekends

requirements: Use at least three visualizations to support distinct findings about reservations and rates.
Explain populations, denominators, and relevant exceptions.
Conclude with a concise operational recommendation and at least one limitation.

criteria.name: Analytical evidence
criteria.description: Full credit requires the case's major relationships, correct comparisons and denominators, and reproducible evidence. Award proportional credit for independently supported partial findings; unsupported claims earn no discovery credit.

criteria.name: Business interpretation
criteria.description: Recommendations follow the evidence, acknowledge unmeasured explanations, and explain business relevance. Reduce credit for unsupported mechanisms or irrelevant recommendations.

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.description: Charts are appropriate, clearly labeled, and accompanied by concise interpretations that meet the assignment requirements. Award partial credit according to clarity and completeness.

notes: Count duplicate conclusions once, even when visualized differently.
Review valid unlisted findings on their evidence and relevance; they are not automatically false positives.
